questions.stem: A student claims that 'plants do not need a transport system because they do not move'. Why is this statement incorrect?

options.text: Because plants do move around using their roots
Because plants actually have a heart-like structure in their roots
Because only very small plants can survive without a transport system
Because even though plants are stationary, their cells still need water, minerals, and sugars delivered to them

questions.explanation: Although plants do not move, every living cell in the plant still requires water, minerals, and sugars for metabolic processes. Large plants cannot rely on diffusion alone because they have a small surface area to volume ratio, so they need xylem and phloem to transport these substances efficiently throughout the plant body.
